description.text: The 2014 promotion began in France on 2 April. In the United States, from 23 May to 12 June 2014, each Pokémon XY Happy Meal held one of 12 cards with a McDonald's M stamp on the picture and one of 12 battle launcher toys. Other major markets followed later in the year.

sources.title: PocketMonsters.net: Pokémon Happy Meals Coming Soon to McDonald's Locations in the US (the 2014 press release)
